text:
The abstract describes a review of existing extracellular vesicle isolation methods, their limitations, and emerging microfluidic approaches, without presenting any experimental work on a thermosensitive copolymer (PNB) or aptamer‑based capture at a specific temperature. It does not propose or test a hypothesis about a PNB‑aptamer system improving exosome yield and purity from mesenchymal stem cells. Therefore, the candidate hypothesis is not the main hypothesis supported by this study.

VERDICT: REJECT
